cohort: 414 healthy full-term newborns with birth weight >=2.000g, who were exclusively breastfed, and excluding twins and those undergoing phototherapy as well as those discharged after 96 hours of life
finding: Caesarean delivery was an independent predictor for weight loss >8% in exclusively breastfed full-term newborns in a Baby-Friendly Hospital.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was an independent predictor for weight loss >8% in exclusively breastfed full-term newborns.
